title: KPDCL Schedules Power Shutdown in Parts of Kashmir - Kashmir Life
full_text:
SRINAGAR: Power supply to several areas of south Kashmir will remain affected from 9 am to 3 pm on October 15 due to scheduled shutdowns of multiple 33 kV transmission lines, the Kashmir Power Distribution Corporation Limited (KPDCL) has said.
According to the Chief Engineer, Distribution, KPDCL, the shutdowns will affect the 33 kV Lassipora–Reshipora, Lassipora–Landoora, Lassipora–Keegam, Buildtech/SIDCO-II and Lassipora–SIDCO IGC lines.
Areas likely to be affected include Zainapora, Chitragam, Sugan, Turkewangam, Watchi, Babpora, Momen, Hermain, Hajipora, Chakoora, Pakherpora, Hawl, Rajpora, Rahmoo, Keegam, Gulshanabad, Akhal, Chararipora, Tenghar, Koil, Tengpuna, Pinglena, Gundipora, Gangoo, Arihal, Achan, Udoora, Ahgam and Lassipora.
The shutdown will also affect all 11 kV outgoing feeders of the SIDCO Lassipora industrial area during the specified hours.
